compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

On the shared tickets branch, `rebar store fsck` reports 1 counted `ORPHAN_EVENT`. The same row appears on the production MCP clone and on the operator clone, observed 2026-11-04 01:50 PST:

- File: `77b6-868f-f4bd-461f/1793763291917454423-f07d2f27-191e-4bd7-9091-1b10efb7ed38-TAG_DELTA.json`
- Status: tracked, not retired.

History of the ticket on `tickets`:
- `2c7a33d9032` — 2026-11-03 19:34:53 PST — Rebar Bot (MCP) — TAG_DELTA
- `c1343e50cd2` — 2026-11-03 19:35:17 PST — Rebar Bot Nava (operator host) — COMPACT, which wrote SNAPSHOT `4febf54c` (timestamp 1793763314322638001)

That SNAPSHOT's `source_event_uuids` holds only the CREATE (5cdd6767) and the LINK (a993ab40). The TAG_DELTA's timestamp precedes the snapshot's, so replay skips it and the tag change is lost from the ticket's state.

## Root cause (from tickets-branch history)

- The operator sweep last merged origin at `9441b0f7b85` (19:34:30 PST). The MCP TAG_DELTA (19:34:53) reached origin at 19:35:10 (`33d5b2da314`). The operator COMPACT `c1343e50cd2` has parent `ee354bb4ffe`, which does not contain `2c7a33d9032` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` fails). The union merge `70bc54fbadb` (19:35:31) brought the TAG_DELTA in after the snapshot was committed.
- CREATE (02:48 UTC) and LINK (02:49 UTC) were ~46 min old, past the 30 min `compact.COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS` default (`src/rebar/_config_schema.py`, `COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS`), so both folded; the fold saw no younger live event.
- `_fold_under_lock` in `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py` places the SNAPSHOT at `max_old + 1` only when a younger live event exists. With no younger event it calls `hlc.next_tick(...)`, i.e. the fold's wall clock. The snapshot timestamp 1793763314.3 s is the fold time, not LINK + 1 ns.
- So the horizon's documented guarantee (config comment on `COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS`: "The SNAPSHOT is timestamped at the fold boundary, so younger hot-edge events ... sort AFTER the snapshot") does not hold when the folding clone has no young event locally. Any event another clone wrote between the newest folded event and the fold time, not yet fetched, lands before the snapshot and is orphaned.

## Approach

Make the no-young-event branch use the same fold-boundary placement as the young-event branch whenever the horizon is positive: `snapshot_ts = max(folded timestamps) + 1`. That restores the existing RC2b design intent for this case; no new mechanism or config. Keep `horizon <= 0` on `hlc.next_tick` (the fold-everything path used by `rebar archive` via `src/rebar/_commands/leaf.py` `--horizon=0`, and by the `_race_orphan` tests in `tests/unit/test_fold_orphan_laundering.py`), since that path documents no concurrency guarantee. Extract the placement decision into a small helper so `_fold_under_lock` does not grow in complexity.

Out of scope: `compact_rebuild.rebuild_snapshot_under_lock` also places its SNAPSHOT at `hlc.next_tick`; that operator-run repair path has the same race and is tracked as bug valiant-supreme-erin. The data repair of the existing 77b6 row is a separate operator step, tracked as task respirable-trapezial-ekaltadeta.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py` — snapshot placement helper; no-young branch uses the fold boundary under a positive horizon.
- `tests/unit/test_fold_horizon_placement.py` (new) — in-process fold with a pinned `hlc._clock`.
- `tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py` (new) — 2-clone reproduction using the `two_clones` fixture from `tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py`.

## Testing

- Unit (failing first): seed a ticket at T0, fold at T0 + 46 min with a 30 min horizon and no young event; assert the SNAPSHOT timestamp equals the newest folded timestamp + 1. Then land a hidden TAG_DELTA stamped at T0 + 45.6 min (written after the newest folded event, before the fold) and assert it sorts after the SNAPSHOT, replays (tag present), and fsck reports no `ORPHAN_EVENT`.
- Edge: `horizon=0` keeps `next_tick` placement (snapshot sorts after every folded event and at or after the fold clock).
- Edge: with a young event present, placement is unchanged (`max_old + 1`, young event still replays).
- Integration (failing first): clone A creates a ticket at pinned T0; clone B fetches, adds a tag at T1 = T0 + 46 min and pushes; clone A folds at T1 + 24 s with `--skip-sync` and a 30 min horizon, then fetches and merges. Assert A's replay holds the tag and fsck on A reports 0 `ORPHAN_EVENT`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The cause is recorded on this ticket with a 2-clone reproduction: `pytest tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py -m ""` fails on the pre-fix tree and passes after.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_fold_horizon_placement.py` fails on the pre-fix tree and passes after.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_fold_orphan_laundering.py tests/unit/test_compact_*.py tests/unit/test_fsck_*.py tests/unit/commands/test_compact_plan.py tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_negative.py` passes, and `pytest tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py -m ""` passes.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0 (complexity ratchet reports no new or increased entry; every `src/rebar` file stays at or under 800 lines).
- [ ] The fix lands on `main` through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
